verificationUnion.name: Verify reference data and scan integrity
verificationUnion.run: node --test tests/*.test.mjs

verificationUnion.name: Verify preserved citation evidence
verificationUnion.run:
mkdir -p artifacts/citation-evidence-seals
evidence_base="$EVIDENCE_BASE_SHA"
if [ -z "$evidence_base" ] || [ "$evidence_base" = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]; then
  evidence_base="$(git rev-parse HEAD^)"
fi
set +e
node tools/citation-evidence-seals.mjs --check --manifest research/citation-evidence-seals.json --baseline-ref "$evidence_base" > artifacts/citation-evidence-seals/report.json 2> artifacts/citation-evidence-seals/errors.txt
evidence_status=$?
set -e
echo "$evidence_status" > artifacts/citation-evidence-seals/validation-exit-status.txt
cat artifacts/citation-evidence-seals/report.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
cat artifacts/citation-evidence-seals/errors.txt
exit "$evidence_status"

verificationUnion.name: Verify committed static output is current
verificationUnion.run:
node tools/assemble.mjs
git diff --exit-code -- dist

verificationUnion.name: Generate citation systemic inventory
verificationUnion.run:
set +e
node tools/citation-systemic-inventory.mjs --output-dir artifacts/citation-systemic-coverage
report_status=$?
set -e
if [ -f artifacts/citation-systemic-coverage/citation-systemic-summary.md ]; then
  sed -n '1,35p' artifacts/citation-systemic-coverage/citation-systemic-summary.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
else
  mkdir -p artifacts/citation-systemic-coverage
  echo "Citation systemic inventory unavailable: generator exited before writing its summary (status ${report_status})." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  echo "Generator did not write citation-systemic-summary.md (exit status ${report_status})." > artifacts/citation-systemic-coverage/generation-error.txt
  if [ "$report_status" -eq 0 ]; then report_status=1; fi
fi
exit "$report_status"

verificationUnion.name: Reconcile source-table row citations
verificationUnion.run:
set +e
node tools/source-table-citation-coverage.mjs artifacts/source-table-citation-coverage/report.json --check
table_status=$?
set -e
if [ -f artifacts/source-table-citation-coverage/report.md ]; then
  cat artifacts/source-table-citation-coverage/report.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
fi
exit "$table_status"

verificationUnion.name: Verify citation owner identity
verificationUnion.run:
mkdir -p artifacts/source-owner-identity
set +e
node tools/source-owner-identity-audit.mjs --check --replay --write artifacts/source-owner-identity/report.json > artifacts/source-owner-identity/check.json
owner_status=$?
set -e
echo "$owner_status" > artifacts/source-owner-identity/validation-exit-status.txt
echo "Citation owners are checked by collection and entry ID; explicit comparator sources remain separately validated." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
cat artifacts/source-owner-identity/check.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
exit "$owner_status"

verificationUnion.name: Verify monetary source inventory
verificationUnion.run:
set +e
node tools/monetary-source-inventory.mjs --check research/monetary-source-inventory.json
monetary_status=$?
set -e
mkdir -p artifacts/monetary-source-inventory
if [ -f research/monetary-source-inventory.json ]; then cp research/monetary-source-inventory.json artifacts/monetary-source-inventory/; fi
echo "$monetary_status" > artifacts/monetary-source-inventory/validation-exit-status.txt
echo "The monetary inventory preserves source occurrences, package quantities, unresolved pointers and separate XP values. Its declared source scopes do not certify whole-book completeness." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
exit "$monetary_status"

verificationUnion.name: Verify recorded monetary row identity findings
verificationUnion.run:
mkdir -p artifacts/monetary-row-identity
set +e
node tools/monetary-findings-register.mjs --check > artifacts/monetary-row-identity/finding-register.json
register_status=$?
node tools/monetary-row-identity-audit.mjs --output artifacts/monetary-row-identity/report.json --check > artifacts/monetary-row-identity/summary.json
row_status=$?
set -e
echo "$register_status" > artifacts/monetary-row-identity/finding-register-exit-status.txt
echo "$row_status" > artifacts/monetary-row-identity/validation-exit-status.txt
echo "Known monetary findings require exact current independent dispositions. New duplicate-focus candidates and source ambiguities remain visible; a clean structural check does not certify source completeness." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
cat artifacts/monetary-row-identity/finding-register.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
cat artifacts/monetary-row-identity/summary.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
if [ "$register_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$register_status"; fi
exit "$row_status"

verificationUnion.name: Join monetary values with current review coverage
verificationUnion.run: node tools/monetary-coverage-report.mjs --output artifacts/monetary-review-coverage/report.json

verificationUnion.name: Verify current monetary source question dispositions
verificationUnion.run:
mkdir -p artifacts/monetary-review-coverage
node tools/monetary-current-source-questions.mjs --output artifacts/monetary-review-coverage/current-source-questions.json --check

verificationUnion.name: Verify duplicated monetary focus declarations
verificationUnion.run:
mkdir -p artifacts/monetary-group-focus
node tools/monetary-group-focus-audit.mjs --output artifacts/monetary-group-focus/report.json --check
echo "Grouped focus declarations must match their exact primary rows. This consistency check does not certify source pixels or values." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

verificationUnion.name: Inventory monetary conditions and source contracts
verificationUnion.run:
node tools/monetary-condition-coverage.mjs --output artifacts/monetary-condition-coverage/report.json
echo "All recorded monetary conditions and declared source contracts remain visible. Changed conditions require independent source review; empty metadata is not source-absence evidence." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

verificationUnion.name: Validate raster boundary coverage snapshot
verificationUnion.run:
node tools/source-raster-coverage.mjs --output artifacts/source-raster-coverage/report.json --check
echo "The raster snapshot is reconciled against every live catalog use and its component-derived metrics. Boundary candidates require visual review; CI does not rerender private source PDFs or prove semantic context." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

verificationUnion.name: Check current citation field captions
verificationUnion.run: node tools/source-target-label-audit.mjs --current --check --output-dir artifacts/citation-target-labels

verificationUnion.name: Inventory quantity and source absence assertions
verificationUnion.run:
node tools/quantity-source-absence-audit.mjs --output-dir artifacts/quantity-source-absence --check
echo "Quantity uncertainty is inventoried across every scalar property in the current catalog and all nine monetary inputs. Lexical candidates and null metadata do not establish what the printed source contains." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

verificationUnion.name: Verify monetary unit provenance
verificationUnion.run:
node tools/monetary-unit-provenance-audit.mjs --output-dir artifacts/monetary-unit-provenance --check
cat artifacts/monetary-unit-provenance/report.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

verificationUnion.name: Verify UA source context obligations
verificationUnion.run:
mkdir -p artifacts/ua-source-context-obligations
node tools/ua-source-context-obligations-cli.mjs --output artifacts/ua-source-context-obligations/report.json
node tools/ua-source-context-obligations-cli.mjs --check
echo "UA table contexts, source frames and note dependencies are checked structurally. Note applicability and source pixels require independent review." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

verificationUnion.name: Verify current continuation candidate snapshot
verificationUnion.run:
node tools/continuation-candidates-validate.mjs --current-snapshot --force-current-tree --output-dir artifacts/continuation-candidate-coverage
cat artifacts/continuation-candidate-coverage/validation.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

verificationUnion.name: Verify declared continuation aliases
verificationUnion.run: node tools/continuation-alias-audit.mjs --output artifacts/continuation-aliases/report.json --check

verificationUnion.name: Inventory consecutive-page excerpt candidates
verificationUnion.run: node tools/cross-page-catalog-candidates.mjs --baseline-output artifacts/continuation-candidate-coverage/cross-page-baseline.json --current-output artifacts/continuation-candidate-coverage/cross-page-current.json

verificationUnion.name: Generate source visual coverage
verificationUnion.run:
set +e
node tools/source-visual-coverage.mjs artifacts/source-visual-coverage
visual_status=$?
set -e
if [ -f artifacts/source-visual-coverage/report.md ]; then
  sed -n '1,35p' artifacts/source-visual-coverage/report.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  echo "Full binding-level JSON and Markdown are available in the source-visual-coverage artifact." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
else
  mkdir -p artifacts/source-visual-coverage
  echo "Source visual coverage unavailable: generator exited before writing its report (status ${visual_status})." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  echo "Generator did not write report.md (exit status ${visual_status})." > artifacts/source-visual-coverage/generation-error.txt
  if [ "$visual_status" -eq 0 ]; then visual_status=1; fi
fi
exit "$visual_status"

verificationUnion.name: Check class advancement and source qualifiers
verificationUnion.run:
mkdir -p artifacts/source-domain-audits
set +e
node tools/class-progression-audit.mjs --input dist/data.json --output artifacts/source-domain-audits/class-progression.json --check
class_status=$?
node tools/source-qualifier-coverage.mjs --input dist/data.json --output artifacts/source-domain-audits/source-qualifiers.json --check
qualifier_status=$?
node tools/ua26-note-marker-audit.mjs > artifacts/source-domain-audits/ua26-note-markers.json
marker_status=$?
set -e
echo "Class-domain and source-qualifier JSON reports are in the source-domain-audits artifact. Generic semantic qualifier completeness is not certified." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
if [ "$class_status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$qualifier_status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$marker_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi

verificationUnion.name: Verify published gaps match current coverage reports
verificationUnion.run:
set -o pipefail
mkdir -p artifacts/source-domain-audits
node tools/refresh-gaps-handoff.mjs --check | tee artifacts/source-domain-audits/gaps-handoff-check.json

verificationUnion.name: Verify coverage report counts and review scopes
verificationUnion.run:
mkdir -p artifacts/source-domain-audits
node tools/source-report-consistency-audit.mjs --check > artifacts/source-domain-audits/report-consistency.json
